title: New High Speed 700T for Taiwan Unveiled at Rollout Ceremony
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.note: A 700T train was unveiled at Kawasaki's Hyogo Works on 30 January 2004. The manufacturer identifies Japan's Series 700 as its basis and describes adaptation of the 12-car model to Taiwan's terrain, requirements and laws.
